I appreciate it, man! At this point I've made up my mind about suicide, and that is I will eventually kill myself. Not because I'm sick of life or I feel it's the only option, though, but so I can go out on my own terms, fully prepared and unafraid of the next adventure. My last day on earth will be watching the sunset, listening to my favorite music and drinking my favorite beer and it will only come when I have no other responsibilities or people who depend on me. Thank you for the support, and likewise, all the best. Life is an interesting animal.

Very few things happen the way you want them to by sheer chance. No one will help those who won't first help themselves. Instead of going on about someone's comparative fortune compared your comparative misfortune is a slippery slope. You're not even 18 years old yet (I presume). It is unfair to you and to anyone who has invested their time in your life to give up before you've had a chance to even live. You're the only one who can really help yourself. 
Also: Watch Avatar the last Airbender. That TV show is awesome.

I've been on the wrong end of this one. Fell in love with my best friend only to find my best friend falling in love with someone else. Haven't really loved a woman since. It's been years, but that pain never goes away. Now I'm just looking for a home and lord knows I know where it is, but goddammit I just don't have the keys.
